automotive-ev-battery.title: Megawatt charging network: Tesla to launch in Europe with 21 sites
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Tesla will deploy its megawatt truck charging network across Europe starting in 2027, beginning with Germany, France, Benelux, the UK, and Sweden. The initial rollout includes 21 public locations featuring over 100 megawatt charging points, marking a significant expansion of high-power charging infrastructure for electric heavy-duty vehicles.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Vinci invests €90 million in MCS truck charging network
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Vinci Concessions, Épopée Gestion, and ADEME Investissement are jointly investing €90 million to develop a fast-charging network for electric trucks across Europe. The project will establish approximately 20 initial locations primarily in France, with expansion planned for Germany and Spain through the Voltix partnership.

automotive-ev-battery.title: BMZ Poland and EVE develop LMFP battery for heavy-duty commercial vehicles
automotive-ev-battery.summary: BMZ Poland and Chinese cell manufacturer EVE Energy are collaboratively developing the Versora LMFP battery for electric commercial vehicles, offering advantages including reduced weight, higher charging power, and improved cold-weather performance compared to LFP technology. Series production is targeted for mid-2028, representing a significant advance in battery technology for heavy-duty applications.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Milence and Alpitronic announce megawatt charging partnership
automotive-ev-battery.summary: E-truck charging provider Milence and charging station manufacturer Alpitronic have announced a strategic partnership to accelerate megawatt charging infrastructure expansion along key European transport corridors. The collaboration extends beyond infrastructure development to encompass comprehensive ecosystem solutions for commercial vehicle electrification.

automotive-ev-battery.title: NYC selects provider for 700-point kerbside charging network
automotive-ev-battery.summary: New York City authorities have selected US charging provider 'it's electric' to construct a permanent street-level EV charging network featuring approximately 700 charging points across all five city boroughs. The company will replace existing pilot infrastructure and install hundreds of new charging locations over the next three years.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Juna: 100 electric trucks now operating across Europe
automotive-ev-battery.summary: The Scania-Sennder joint venture Juna currently operates approximately 110 electric trucks across four European countries, with plans to expand the fleet to around 150 vehicles by the end of 2026. The company employs a pay-per-use business model designed to facilitate the transition to electromobility for transport companies.

automotive-ev-battery.title: India-EU FTA to cut tariffs on up to 315,000 EVs annually
automotive-ev-battery.summary: The European Commission has revealed that its proposed Free Trade Agreement with India could facilitate tariff reductions on up to 315,000 electric vehicles traded between the two markets annually. The combined annual quota will reach this figure in phases should the FTA enter into force under the published tariff schedules.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Porsche Cayenne Electric now available with wireless charging
automotive-ev-battery.summary: The Porsche Cayenne Electric is now offered with inductive wireless charging technology, which transmits charging current via a magnetic field between an embedded vehicle floor pad and a base plate. This technology represents an advancement in consumer EV charging convenience.

automotive-ev-battery.title: EKPO unveils next-gen fuel cell stack
automotive-ev-battery.summary: EKPO Fuel Cell Technologies, a joint venture between ElringKlinger and OPmobility, will showcase the next generation of its NM20 fuel cell stack at IAA Transportation 2026. The development aims to advance the industrialization of hydrogen-based powertrains for heavy-duty commercial vehicle applications.

automotive-ev-battery.title: India: Ultraviolette Automotive to set up new 250,000-unit e-2W plant
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Indian electric two-wheeler manufacturer Ultraviolette Automotive plans to establish a production facility with annual capacity of 250,000 units, facilitating its expansion from premium vehicle segments into lower-priced, high-volume market segments. This capacity increase supports the growing demand for electric two-wheelers in emerging markets.

world-news.title: Congress passes sweeping US sanctions bill targeting Russia
world-news.summary: The US Congress has passed significant sanctions legislation targeting Russia, marking the first such congressional action in over two years in support of Ukraine. The measure represents a major geopolitical statement on US commitment to Ukraine and escalates pressure on the Russian economy.

world-news.title: Iran war live: Trump says US nearing end of war, claims Tehran direct talks
world-news.summary: President Trump announced that the United States is nearing the end of conflict with Iran and claimed direct diplomatic negotiations are underway with Tehran. The statement signals a potential shift in US-Iran relations and regional tensions in the Middle East.

world-news.title: EU chief backs plan for Canada to become 'associate member'
world-news.summary: The European Union leadership has endorsed a proposal for Canada to gain 'associate member' status, prompting Trump to threaten retaliatory trade measures against both Canada and the EU. The dispute threatens significant trade disruptions among major Western allies.

world-news.title: US interest rates raised for first time in three years
world-news.summary: The Federal Reserve unanimously approved an interest rate increase despite opposition from President Trump, who had advocated for a cut. The decision reflects diverging views on monetary policy within the Trump administration and carries significant implications for global financial markets.

world-news.title: Israel and Morocco agree to open embassies, upgrading diplomatic ties
world-news.summary: Israel and Morocco have agreed to establish embassies and expand air travel connections, marking a significant upgrade in their diplomatic relationship. The agreement includes plans to resume direct commercial flights between the two nations.

world-news.title: US military claims Strait of Hormuz remains open amid ongoing blockade
world-news.summary: A US CENTCOM spokesperson asserted that the Strait of Hormuz remains operationally open despite reports of an ongoing blockade affecting this critical global shipping route. The statement addresses mounting concerns over disruptions to international maritime commerce through one of the world's most vital waterways.

world-news.title: UK and Canada discuss AI risks and defence ties in first bilateral meeting
world-news.summary: The United Kingdom and Canada held their first bilateral meeting to address artificial intelligence risks, defence cooperation, and joint strategic initiatives. The dialogue reflects growing international coordination on emerging technology governance and security matters.

world-news.title: Photos show widespread damage at US sites from Iranian attacks
world-news.summary: Images reveal substantial destruction at US military facilities resulting from Iranian attacks, including a damaged air force aircraft and destroyed buildings. The documentation provides evidence of the physical toll of escalating US-Iran military tensions.

world-news.title: 'People don't have money': Syrian fuel hikes deepen economic pain
world-news.summary: Syria faces escalating economic hardship as increased diesel and petrol prices drive up transportation and food costs across the already impoverished nation. The fuel price increases exacerbate the humanitarian crisis affecting the Syrian population.

world-news.title: Eight children among 21 killed after war-damaged Gaza building collapses, rescuers say
world-news.summary: A six-storey building in Gaza City that had been previously damaged in an Israeli strike collapsed, killing 21 people including eight children who were living in the structure. The incident underscores the ongoing humanitarian consequences of the Gaza conflict.

science-space.title: Newfound 'Baby' Planet Smashes Record for Youngest Known World
science-space.summary: Astronomers have confirmed Elias 2-24 b, a planet less than one million years old, as the youngest known world using NASA-funded data archives. The discovery challenges existing planet-formation models, as the baby planet is still embedded in its natal disk of dust and gas.

science-space.title: NASA's Moon Orbiter Spots New, 'Once-in-Century' Moon Crater
science-space.summary: A scientist at NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter discovered an unusually large bright spot with a dark halo on the Moon during a routine data-quality check, indicating a once-in-century crater formation event. The discovery provides insights into recent lunar geological activity and surface dynamics.

science-space.title: The Universe's Most Extreme Dead Stars Can Form from Vampire White Dwarfs
science-space.summary: Scientists have discovered the mechanism by which certain vampire white dwarfs that feed on companion stars can transform into neutron stars under precisely defined conditions. This breakthrough explains a previously mysterious transformation in extreme stellar systems.

science-space.title: Roman Space Telescope Starts Waking Up as NASA Powers On Instruments for the First Time
science-space.summary: NASA has begun powering on the instruments aboard the Roman Space Telescope as it travels toward its destination nearly a million miles from Earth in preparation for its scientific mission. This milestone marks a critical phase in preparing the observatory for conducting astronomical observations.

science-space.title: NASA's Integrated Medical Model (IMM)
science-space.summary: NASA has developed the Integrated Medical Model, a decision-support tool designed to anticipate the medical challenges of long-duration crewed missions to the Moon and Mars, accounting for cosmic radiation, microgravity, and distance from Earth. The IMM enables NASA to prepare astronauts for the unique health considerations of deep-space exploration.

science-space.title: Curiosity Postcard Celebrates Rover's 5,000th Day on Mars
science-space.summary: NASA's Curiosity Mars rover has reached a major milestone of 5,000 days on the Red Planet, capturing panoramic images from its location at a sand ridge nicknamed 'Chocolatal.' The achievement underscores the rover's remarkable longevity and continued scientific contributions to Mars exploration.

science-space.title: NASA Watches Earth's Weight, Finds Center of Mass
science-space.summary: NASA scientists are tracking seasonal water redistribution around Earth that shifts the planet's center of mass relative to its geometric center by fractions of an inch. This research is critical for maintaining accuracy in satellite navigation systems and elevation measurements worldwide.

science-space.title: SpaceX Falcon 9 Rocket-Landing Team Gets First-Ever Neil Armstrong Space Prize
science-space.summary: The SpaceX Falcon 9 Booster Landing Team received the inaugural Neil Armstrong Space Prize during a ceremony in Washington, D.C., recognizing their achievement in reusable rocket technology. The award honors innovations that advance human spaceflight capabilities.

science-space.title: NASA Celebrates Restoration of Guam Station Damaged by Typhoon Mawar
science-space.summary: NASA celebrated the complete restoration of its Guam Remote Station with a ribbon-cutting ceremony, concluding more than three years of recovery following Super Typhoon Mawar's devastation in 2023. The final and most complex phase of the rebuild was completed in July with the restoration of critical satellite communication equipment.

science-space.title: Where Will the US Space Academy Be Based?
science-space.summary: NASA is seeking a state location for the newly announced U.S. Space Academy, with groundbreaking targeted for 2027 and classes expected to begin by 2028. The academy represents a significant institutional expansion in space workforce development and education.

finance-markets.title: Fed defies Trump with first rate rise since 2023
finance-markets.summary: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time since 2023, signaling its commitment to controlling inflation despite President Trump's calls for borrowing costs to fall to 1%. The central bank's decision and willingness to pursue further tightening marks a significant policy stance independent of political pressure.

finance-markets.title: Treasuries Pare Losses From Fed Hike, Dollar Gains: Markets Wrap
finance-markets.summary: Treasury yields stabilized following the Federal Reserve's first interest rate increase since 2023, as Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's inflation-fighting resolve reassured markets. The dollar strengthened while oil prices extended their decline amid broader market adjustments to the rate decision.

finance-markets.title: Trump Bans Canadian Goods From US Government Purchases
finance-markets.summary: President Trump has directed federal agencies to exclude Canadian goods from government contracts, escalating trade tensions between the United States and Canada. The action represents a concrete implementation of Trump's earlier threats regarding bilateral trade relations.

finance-markets.title: Trump suggests EU-Canada associate member deal would be 'hostile act'
finance-markets.summary: President Trump threatened to impose severe tariffs on the European Union if it approves a proposal to make Canada the first associate member of the bloc. The threat represents an escalation in trade tensions as the Trump administration signals its opposition to closer EU-Canada ties.

finance-markets.title: NSE Subscription for India IPO Starts With Valuation in Focus
finance-markets.summary: India's National Stock Exchange launched its highly anticipated initial public offering, though investor appetite remains uncertain given a valuation that appears elevated relative to comparable global exchanges. The IPO represents a significant milestone for the exchange and a test of market sentiment toward Indian financial infrastructure.

finance-markets.title: Berkshire May Boost Japan Trading House Holdings, Itochu Says
finance-markets.summary: Berkshire Hathaway is reportedly considering increasing its stakes in Japanese trading houses, according to industry group representatives. The potential expansion would deepen the investment company's exposure to Japan's major commercial trading enterprises.

finance-markets.title: Oil Extends Drop as Saudi Arabia Moves to Restore Vital Pipeline
finance-markets.summary: Crude oil prices fell for a second consecutive day as Saudi Arabia prepares to restore a critical supply pipeline, signaling an easing of Middle East supply disruptions. The pipeline restoration suggests an improvement in global energy supply conditions in the near term.

finance-markets.title: China's Gas Demand Outlook Clouded by Guangdong's Power Shift
finance-markets.summary: Electricity market reforms in Guangdong, a major Chinese economic hub, could signal broader weakness in China's natural gas demand outlook. The shift in energy sourcing may have significant implications for regional and global gas markets.

finance-markets.title: Walter and Boehly sell Chelsea FC stakes to Clearlake for £950mn
finance-markets.summary: Chelsea Football Club investors Todd Boehly and Clearlake Capital have executed a £950 million stake sale, providing liquidity as their insurance operations face increased regulatory scrutiny. The transaction reflects efforts to rebalance their investment portfolios amid business pressures.

finance-markets.title: Morgan Stanley Says Bathla Shows Need for More Credit Disclosure
finance-markets.summary: Morgan Stanley researchers have called for enhanced financial disclosures to better assess credit risk among property developers, citing lessons from Sydney's Bathla Group collapse. The recommendation highlights gaps in market transparency regarding real estate sector credit exposure.

tech-ai.title: Anthropic and OpenAI want to embed safety evaluators. Will they really be independent?
tech-ai.summary: Anthropic and OpenAI are proposing to embed independent safety evaluators within their AI labs to increase oversight of advanced AI systems. While researchers welcome the unprecedented access, concerns remain about whether true independence and transparency can be maintained without formal regulation.

tech-ai.title: Claude comes for Gemini with its own take on Docs and Slides
tech-ai.summary: Anthropic has launched Docs and Slides tools for Claude, enabling users to create and export documents and presentations directly through the AI assistant. The company is also consolidating its Claude interface into a single unified chat experience with all productivity features integrated.

tech-ai.title: Google will now let any AI agent run your smart home
tech-ai.summary: Google is opening its smart home ecosystem to third-party AI agents including Claude and Open Claw through a new Model Context Protocol integration. This allows multiple AI assistants to access and control connected devices, analyzing home data and acting on users' behalf.

tech-ai.title: The AI data center e-waste problem is huge — and getting bigger
tech-ai.summary: A new report reveals that e-waste from AI data centers has been significantly underestimated, potentially reaching enough trash by 2050 to fill 23 million shipping containers. The study's broader scope accounts for all supporting infrastructure, providing a clearer picture of the environmental impact of AI infrastructure.

tech-ai.title: Apple might make servers again to cash in on the AI rush
tech-ai.summary: Apple is reportedly planning to re-enter the server market and may partner with Nvidia to manufacture AI-optimized servers using its efficient ARM-based M processors. The move capitalizes on growing demand for compute power in the expanding AI industry, marking Apple's return to enterprise hardware after retiring its Xserve line in 2011.

tech-ai.title: Snap is launching a new Specs AI tool, and it's coming to iOS and Mac
tech-ai.summary: Snap has introduced Specs Intelligence, a new AI assistant available on iOS and Mac that connects digital accounts to help manage work tasks and travel information. The assistant positions itself as an anticipatory AI service designed to prioritize daily needs while supporting long-term goals, competing with similar offerings from Meta and Google.

tech-ai.title: Al Gore has a surprisingly calm take on the AI data center backlash
tech-ai.summary: Former Vice President Al Gore expressed measured concerns about AI data center emissions in an interview, noting he is more focused on the AI industry's own warnings about existential risks. His pragmatic stance contrasts with broader environmental concerns about the computational demands of artificial intelligence.

tech-ai.title: Snap tries to make the case again for its $2,200 smart glasses
tech-ai.summary: Snap unveiled new features for its premium Specs augmented reality glasses, which enable shared digital experiences between multiple users in real-world settings. The company continues to pitch the device as a compelling platform despite its high price point and competitive smart glasses market.

tech-ai.title: Pulley, a Carta rival, is shutting down
tech-ai.summary: Pulley, a cap table management platform backed by prominent venture firms including General Catalyst, Stripe, and Founders Fund, announced it will cease operations in December. The shutdown reflects competitive pressures in the equity management software space dominated by incumbent Carta.

tech-ai.title: After accusations of selling 'perv glasses,' Meta prepares to sell a pair without a camera
tech-ai.summary: Meta is developing a new smart glasses variant without an integrated camera in response to privacy concerns about its existing wearable technology. The move addresses criticism over potential surveillance issues while maintaining the smart glasses form factor.

health-biotech.title: U.S. reaches highest number of measles deaths in decades
health-biotech.summary: The United States has reached its highest number of measles deaths in decades, signaling a significant public health concern. This development underscores growing challenges with vaccine-preventable diseases and immunization rates across the country.

health-biotech.title: WHO expresses cautious optimism about bid to control Ebola outbreak in DRC
health-biotech.summary: The World Health Organization has expressed cautious optimism regarding efforts to control the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The assessment suggests progress in containment and response measures despite the ongoing public health challenge.

health-biotech.title: Scientists made mice with half a brain. Then they filled them with human organoids
health-biotech.summary: Researchers have created mice with half a brain and populated the remaining space with human neural organoids, potentially opening new avenues for neurological disease research. The breakthrough raises important ethical considerations regarding chimeric organisms and the extent of humanization in animal models.

health-biotech.title: Novartis' TREM2 drug fails Phase 2 ALS trial
health-biotech.summary: Novartis has discontinued development of VHB937/lifonebart after the compound failed to meet efficacy endpoints in a Phase 2 trial for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. The decision represents a significant setback in the search for disease-modifying treatments for this devastating neurodegenerative condition.

health-biotech.title: Skyhawk says its Huntington's drug improved symptoms in extension to Phase 1/2 trial
health-biotech.summary: Skyhawk Therapeutics reported that its RNA-splicing candidate SKY-0515 demonstrated symptom improvement in an extended Phase 1/2 trial for Huntington's disease. The positive early-stage data supports advancement to pivotal development for this rare genetic neurological disorder.

health-biotech.title: Novartis to pay $125M for blood-brain barrier crossing platform
health-biotech.summary: Novartis has acquired global rights to Sironax's blood-brain barrier crossing technology platform for $125 million to advance three candidate drugs targeting central nervous system disorders. The acquisition addresses a critical challenge in neurological drug development and positions Novartis to develop potentially best-in-class therapies.

health-biotech.title: Drugmakers cooperate with House probe of China trial sites
health-biotech.summary: Five major pharmaceutical companies are cooperating with a congressional investigation led by Rep. John Moolenaar into clinical trials conducted at Chinese military hospitals. The probe raises questions about transparency, oversight, and regulatory standards in international clinical research.

health-biotech.title: Sen. Warren demands to see Trump drug-pricing pharma contracts, accuses RFK Jr. of hiding them
health-biotech.summary: Senator Elizabeth Warren has requested disclosure of pharma contracts related to Trump administration drug pricing policies and accused RFK Jr. of withholding information. The development reflects ongoing congressional scrutiny of pharmaceutical pricing initiatives and regulatory transparency.

health-biotech.title: Pharmalittle: FDA opens applications for pilot program to speed drug development
health-biotech.summary: The FDA has announced applications are now open for a pilot program designed to accelerate the timeline for pharmaceutical companies to initiate human clinical trials. The initiative aims to streamline the investigational new drug application process.

health-biotech.title: Novo signs Anthropic deal to test Claude Science in R&D
health-biotech.summary: Novo Nordisk has partnered with Anthropic to integrate Claude Science capabilities into pharmaceutical research and development operations. The collaboration represents a growing trend of major drugmakers adopting advanced artificial intelligence technologies to enhance drug discovery processes.

startups-vc.title: How Fortell is using AI (and $163M) to crack a hearing aid monopoly
startups-vc.summary: AI-powered hearing aid startup Fortell has raised $163 million from top-tier investors including Founders Fund, Thrive Capital, and Valor Equity to disrupt the hearing aid market. The company aims to address the low adoption rate of hearing aids by developing AI-enhanced devices with improved user experience and accessibility.

startups-vc.title: Pulley, a Carta rival, is shutting down
startups-vc.summary: Cap table management platform Pulley, backed by prominent investors General Catalyst, Stripe, and Founders Fund, announced its closure in December. The shutdown reflects consolidation pressures in the cap table software market dominated by Carta.

startups-vc.title: Former Infosys chief's AI startup nabs another $53M
startups-vc.summary: A Palo Alto-based AI startup founded by a former Infosys executive has secured an additional $53 million in funding just weeks after its initial raise. The company has reportedly landed multiple seven-figure enterprise contracts within months of launch, demonstrating strong market traction.

startups-vc.title: Clean tech startup Fluxnium found a way to tap 50,000 years' worth of nuclear fuel
startups-vc.summary: Clean technology startup Fluxnium has developed fiber technology capable of extracting uranium directly from seawater, unlocking vast reserves of nuclear fuel sufficient to power multiple generations. The innovation represents a significant advancement in sustainable nuclear energy sourcing.

startups-vc.title: Noise wants to help everyday people become paid content creators
startups-vc.summary: Marketing platform Noise is launching to democratize content monetization by enabling individuals with smartphones to generate income from their content creation. The platform addresses the growing creator economy by removing traditional barriers to earning from digital content.

startups-vc.title: Diana Hu Is YC's Newest Managing Partner
startups-vc.summary: Y Combinator has promoted Diana Hu to Managing Partner, recognizing her dual track record of founding a startup and shipping technology to 100 million users. The promotion reflects YC's commitment to experienced operator leadership.

startups-vc.title: A Hard Year For Software IPOs
startups-vc.summary: U.S. venture-backed technology companies have achieved approximately $90 billion in domestic public offerings this year, already marking the second-highest annual tally on record with months remaining. The data reflects sustained momentum in public market exits for the tech sector.

startups-vc.title: How To Measure An Innovation Economy: South Korea
startups-vc.summary: South Korea's emergence as the world's eighth-largest national innovation ecosystem demonstrates how sustained government investment, startup programs, regulatory reforms, and deep-tech policies can transform an economy over time. The case study provides insights into building thriving innovation-driven economies.

startups-vc.title: Robots are waiting for a ChatGPT moment: Nvidia's Les Karpas explains why at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
startups-vc.summary: Nvidia executive Les Karpas will discuss the robotics industry's wait for a breakthrough moment comparable to ChatGPT's impact on AI at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. The talk addresses the timing and technological requirements needed for robotics mainstream adoption.

startups-vc.title: Hear why Science Corp CEO Max Hodak says the screen era is ending at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
startups-vc.summary: Science Corp CEO Max Hodak will present a vision for screen-free interfaces with potential medical applications at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, challenging conventional computing paradigms. The presentation explores emerging human-computer interaction models beyond traditional display technology.

cybersecurity.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
cybersecurity.summary: The FBI is investigating a dark web identity theft service offering digital scans of over 153 million U.S. and Canadian driver's licenses, apparently sourced from a Louisiana-based identity verification company. This represents one of the largest personal identity document breaches on record, with significant implications for national security and consumer privacy.

cybersecurity.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 400 Security Holes
cybersecurity.summary: Microsoft released patches addressing at least 398 security vulnerabilities across Windows operating systems and supported software, including one actively exploited vulnerability and two others previously disclosed publicly. The large volume of patches underscores the ongoing challenges organizations face in maintaining system security.

cybersecurity.title: Attackers Exploit Issabel Framework Flaw Enabling Unauthenticated OS Command Execution
cybersecurity.summary: A critical vulnerability in Issabel Framework for open-source unified communications PBX software is under active exploitation, with a CVSS score of 9.8 that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary operating system commands. This poses an immediate threat to organizations using the framework for communications infrastructure.

cybersecurity.title: Attacker Hijacks AI Coding Assistant Session, Spreads Shai-Hulud Across About 100 Repositories
cybersecurity.summary: Mandiant discovered an attacker who compromised an AI coding assistant session at a software-as-a-service provider and subsequently distributed malware across approximately 100 internal code repositories after poisoning the assistant's software recommendations. The incident highlights emerging risks in supply chain attacks involving AI-assisted development tools.

cybersecurity.title: One Extension Could Hijack AI Assistants Across Chrome, Comet, Edge, Opera Neon and Claude
cybersecurity.summary: Security researchers at Forever Security demonstrated that a single malicious browser extension could compromise AI assistants integrated into five major Chromium-based products and Chrome extensions, potentially allowing attackers to access sensitive data and execute unauthorized actions. The vulnerability affects millions of users relying on these AI-powered tools.

cybersecurity.title: N0va Phishkit Targets US and EU Businesses: A New Challenge for Identity Security
cybersecurity.summary: The N0va phishing campaign is targeting organizations across North America and Europe by impersonating legitimate services and exploiting authentication mechanisms to gain unauthorized account access without deploying obvious malware. Successfully compromised accounts provide threat actors with access to sensitive data and enable deeper network infiltration.

cybersecurity.title: Attackers Exploit WooCommerce Wholesale Lead Capture Flaw to Plant PHP Web Shells
cybersecurity.summary: Threat actors are actively exploiting a critical vulnerability in WooCommerce Wholesale Lead Capture, a premium WordPress plugin used by over 6,000 websites, to upload PHP backdoors and achieve remote code execution. Wordfence has blocked exploitation attempts targeting this vulnerability affecting a significant number of e-commerce sites.

cybersecurity.title: Data Broker Radaris Loses Domains in Privacy Fight
cybersecurity.summary: Data broker Radaris.com has faced legal consequences for repeatedly ignoring personal information removal requests from New Jersey residents, resulting in domain seizures following a lawsuit that alleged violations of state privacy law protecting law enforcement officials. The case underscores increased enforcement against data brokers that disregard consumer privacy rights.

cybersecurity.title: Acronis cPanel Backup Plugin Vulnerability Exploited in Targeted Attacks
cybersecurity.summary: A high-severity vulnerability in Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel and Web Host Manager has been exploited in active attacks, allowing local privilege escalation through insecure file permissions with a CVSS score of 7.8. Hosting providers and system administrators using the affected plugin versions are at immediate risk.

cybersecurity.title: Read This Before You Buy That TV Streaming Stick
cybersecurity.summary: Security analysis reveals that generic TV streaming boxes conduct fraudulent activities beyond privacy concerns, including spoofing mobile devices to click ads on AI-generated websites as part of schemes to defraud merchants and advertising networks. These devices pose both privacy and security risks to consumers and enable broader criminal operations.

crypto-web3.title: Hamas military wing told donors to avoid sending crypto directly from Binance, DOJ filing shows
crypto-web3.summary: According to Department of Justice documents, Hamas's military wing has instructed donors to avoid using Binance for fund transfers, instead directing them to use alternative platforms including Trust Wallet, Bybit, OKX, Kast, and Redotpay to send funds to external TRON wallets. The disclosure highlights ongoing concerns about cryptocurrency use in illicit financing and enforcement challenges across multiple blockchain networks.

crypto-web3.title: U.S. House's tax committee advances crypto tax bill in wake of Clarity Act loss
crypto-web3.summary: The House Ways and Means Committee advanced the Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act, which aims to reduce tax compliance burdens for routine cryptocurrency transactions, following the Senate's failure to pass the broader Clarity Act. The legislation represents a legislative pivot toward targeted regulatory measures as comprehensive crypto reform stalls.

crypto-web3.title: 'Go time': SEC, CFTC prepare to push crypto rules as Clarity Act stalls in Senate
crypto-web3.summary: With the Clarity Act failing to advance in the Senate, the SEC and CFTC are positioned to accelerate their independent rulemaking efforts for cryptocurrency markets. CFTC Chair Mike Selig indicated his agency is prepared to implement comprehensive rules for digital asset finance.

crypto-web3.title: Fed raises rates by 25 basis points in first hike since July 2023
crypto-web3.summary: The Federal Reserve increased its benchmark fed funds rate range to 3.75%-4.0%, marking its first rate hike in over a year in a widely expected monetary policy move. The decision carries implications for crypto asset valuations and risk appetite in digital asset markets.

crypto-web3.title: Deutsche Bank plans bitcoin, ether custody for institutional clients in Europe
crypto-web3.summary: Deutsche Bank announced plans to launch digital asset custody services in Europe this year, initially supporting bitcoin, ether, and select stablecoins for institutional clients. The initiative represents continued mainstream financial institution adoption of cryptocurrency infrastructure.

crypto-web3.title: Circle launches Arc mainnet with BlackRock and Visa among validators, mints 10 billion ARC tokens
crypto-web3.summary: Circle completed the genesis mint of 10 billion ARC tokens for its new Arc mainnet, which counts major financial institutions BlackRock and Visa among its validators. The launch underscores institutional interest in blockchain infrastructure, though the company has not yet confirmed a public token launch timeline.

crypto-web3.title: House committee moves to codify Trump's Strategic Bitcoin Reserve
crypto-web3.summary: A House committee advanced legislation to establish a strategic bitcoin reserve, formalizing a proposal to hold bitcoin as part of U.S. government reserves. The bill reflects growing political support for long-term cryptocurrency holdings at the federal level.

crypto-web3.title: Celsius sues BitMEX for $495 million over 2020 crash liquidations
crypto-web3.summary: The Celsius estate filed a $495 million lawsuit against BitMEX seeking recovery for 6,360 BTC lost during liquidations triggered by the 2020 pandemic market crash on a leveraged long position. The case highlights unresolved liability questions from the 2020 market volatility and tensions between Celsius's delta-neutral business model and its actual trading positions.

crypto-web3.title: Revolut hackers demand $3 million in Monero, threaten to sell customer data
crypto-web3.summary: Hackers have demanded $3 million in Monero from fintech platform Revolut and threatened to sell customer data, claiming to have targeted accounts with significant cryptocurrency holdings. The 24-hour ultimatum highlights ongoing cybersecurity risks facing digital finance platforms and their user bases.

crypto-web3.title: Payward plans to offer U.S. clients onchain perpetual futures on Hyperliquid
crypto-web3.summary: Payward, leveraging its $550 million acquisition of Bitnomial, plans to become the first registered U.S. exchange to deploy perpetual futures markets on the Hyperliquid protocol. The move represents a strategic expansion of onchain derivatives offerings to institutional and retail clients within the regulated U.S. market.

energy-climate.title: Analysis: India's power-sector emissions flat for two years due to clean-energy surge
energy-climate.summary: India's power sector has maintained flat carbon dioxide emissions over the past two years despite economic growth, driven by a significant expansion in clean energy capacity. This achievement demonstrates the potential for developing nations to decouple economic growth from fossil fuel emissions through renewable energy deployment.

energy-climate.title: UK aviation emissions to be 50% higher than thought by 2050, government admits
energy-climate.summary: The UK government has revised its aviation emissions projections upward, now forecasting emissions 50 percent higher than previously anticipated by 2050, citing reduced expectations for electric aircraft and sustainable aviation fuel adoption. This admission reflects the challenge of decarbonizing the aviation sector and signals potential policy recalibration for achieving net-zero targets.

energy-climate.title: Analysis: Global fossil-fuel emissions set to fall in 2026 amid Hormuz crisis
energy-climate.summary: Global fossil fuel emissions are projected to decline by approximately 0.5 percent in 2026 as geopolitical tensions in the Hormuz Strait disrupt energy markets and reduce consumption. The analysis indicates that external shocks can temporarily reduce emissions, though structural transitions to renewables remain essential for sustained climate progress.

energy-climate.title: South Korea to replace 15-year-old renewable support scheme with auctions
energy-climate.summary: South Korea will transition from its long-standing Renewable Portfolio Standard to competitive auction mechanisms and long-term fixed-price contracts beginning January 1, 2027. This policy shift reflects evolving approaches to renewable energy procurement in major Asian economies and may influence pricing and deployment strategies across the region.

energy-climate.title: Novva to acquire 3.17GW of Argentine renewable assets from ABO Energy
energy-climate.summary: Novva Group has signed a binding framework agreement to acquire a 3.17 GW portfolio of renewable energy projects from ABO Energy in Argentina, representing significant expansion of renewable capacity in South America. The transaction underscores growing investment in Latin American clean energy infrastructure and consolidation trends in the regional renewable sector.

energy-climate.title: Poland's solar pipeline hits 40.6 GW
energy-climate.summary: An independent Polish research institute reports that its database of solar projects with grid-connection conditions has reached 40.6 GW, demonstrating robust pipeline development despite revised tracking methodologies that exclude inactive projects. The substantial pipeline indicates strong near-term growth potential for Poland's solar energy sector.

energy-climate.title: Zambia inks PPA for 500 MW solar project
energy-climate.summary: Hungary-based developer EnerSynk Group has secured a 25-year power purchase agreement for its 500 MW solar project in Zambia, advancing the project toward financing and implementation stages. The agreement represents a significant renewable energy commitment for Southern Africa and demonstrates continued investment in utility-scale solar development on the continent.

energy-climate.title: ExxonMobil secures regulatory approval for Rose CCS project in Texas
energy-climate.summary: ExxonMobil has obtained regulatory approval to proceed with the Rose carbon capture and storage project in Texas, valued at more than $5 billion. The project advancement reflects growing industry investment in carbon capture technology as part of broader climate mitigation strategies, though questions remain regarding the scalability and cost-effectiveness of CCS deployment.

energy-climate.title: Overcapacity in modules, underdeveloped upstream: The next challenge for Indian PV manufacturing
energy-climate.summary: India's solar manufacturing sector faces challenges with module overcapacity and limited upstream cell production capabilities, hampered by high capital requirements, technology barriers, and reliance on imported equipment. Geopolitical uncertainties and plant stabilization issues threaten to delay cell capacity expansion, potentially constraining India's renewable energy manufacturing growth.

energy-climate.title: Hithium launches 4 MWh sodium-ion BESS with new 785Ah cell
energy-climate.summary: Hithium has introduced the ∞Power N4.0MWh, a 4 MWh sodium-ion battery storage system featuring a 785 Ah cell with a 20,000-cycle lifespan and 30-year design life, with full-scale production targeted for 2027. The sodium-ion technology expansion offers a cost-competitive alternative to lithium-ion batteries for utility, commercial, industrial, and residential applications.

asia-pacific.title: India, Pakistan summon each other's diplomats after naval ships collide in Arabian Sea
asia-pacific.summary: India and Pakistan have summoned each other's top diplomats to lodge formal protests following a collision between their naval vessels in international waters of the Arabian Sea. Both nations have characterized the incident as demonstrating unprofessional conduct, marking a significant escalation in their ongoing maritime tensions.

asia-pacific.title: Only 'idiots' expect North Korea to give up nuclear weapons: Kim Yo-jong
asia-pacific.summary: Kim Yo-jong, sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, declared that the country's nuclear-armed status is permanent and irreversible, dismissing hopes for denuclearization. North Korea has legally enshrined its status as a nuclear weapons state, with estimates of its arsenal ranging from 57 to 120 warheads.

asia-pacific.title: North Korea at Japan's Asian Games: sports diplomacy or propaganda stunt?
asia-pacific.summary: North Korea's record 180-strong delegation to Japan's 2026 Asian Games, led by the sports minister, may signal potential diplomatic overtures toward Washington and Tokyo despite substantial obstacles to formal negotiations. The Games, held in Nagoya and Aichi prefecture, represent an unusual engagement opportunity between the isolated nation and its regional neighbors.

asia-pacific.title: Japan's Natuna port proposal highlights Indonesia's balancing act on China
asia-pacific.summary: Japan's proposed infrastructure upgrades in Indonesia's strategic Natuna Islands reflect Tokyo's expanding security cooperation with Southeast Asia while maintaining ambiguity about containing Beijing. The initiative underscores Japan's shift toward more active regional engagement following its easing of restrictions on lethal weapons exports.

asia-pacific.title: BRICS 2026: A Forum, Not a Front
asia-pacific.summary: India's leadership of the BRICS summit demonstrated the organization functions as a multipolar dialogue platform rather than a unified geopolitical bloc, with attendees pursuing distinct national interests. The summit revealed the complexities of strategic alignment in Asia, with implications for Europe's engagement with major emerging powers.

asia-pacific.title: Will Takaichi visit Kyiv? Zelensky's invite puts Japan PM in diplomatic bind
asia-pacific.summary: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi faces diplomatic pressure following Ukrainian President Zelensky's invitation to visit Kyiv, as she seeks to demonstrate support for Ukraine while avoiding further antagonizing Russia. The decision reflects Japan's delicate balancing act in managing regional security concerns amid broader geopolitical tensions.

asia-pacific.title: Hong Kong's 5-year plan, policy continuity offer investors more stability, experts say
asia-pacific.summary: Hong Kong unveiled its inaugural five-year development plan, with Chief Executive John Lee aligning the city's strategic direction with China's national long-term objectives. The plan is expected to enhance investor confidence by providing greater policy visibility and institutional stability for the financial hub.

asia-pacific.title: South Korea Embraces the Silk Road Spirit With Central Asian Leaders
asia-pacific.summary: South Korea held its first Central Asia-South Korea leaders summit with energy security and critical minerals procurement emerging as key strategic priorities. The diplomatic initiative reflects Seoul's efforts to diversify supply chains and strengthen ties beyond traditional Northeast Asian partnerships.

asia-pacific.title: Will Southeast Asia Actually Benefit From Its AI Boom?
asia-pacific.summary: Despite Southeast Asia's emergence as a significant hub for computing infrastructure and artificial intelligence deployment, the region risks becoming merely a hosting ground without developing indigenous AI innovation capabilities. The imbalance between computational capacity and economic value creation raises questions about sustainable regional development.

asia-pacific.title: Health crisis grips Indonesians enduring haze: 'my eyes sting, my head hurts'
asia-pacific.summary: Indonesia faces a severe air quality crisis as wildfires on Borneo Island produce hazardous smoke affecting residents across the region, with impacts extending to neighboring Malaysia and Brunei. The environmental emergency, exacerbated by El Niño conditions, underscores transnational environmental challenges in Southeast Asia.
